assess.authorizationNote: Only check a domain when its owner has allowed it. Their details are kept as evidence.

tierHelp.exposure: Also reads the website's security headers. This needs proof that the owner controls the domain.

assess.attest: The person named has authority over this domain and has allowed these checks.
assess.verifyNote: The domain owner publishes a DNS record we give you. Until legal review, sample domains verify automatically and no real domain is checked.
assess.fakeNote: Until legal review, results come from invented sample data and no real domain is contacted.

outreach.aiReview: Check this draft before using it. Campaigns using it still need approval.

outreach.noTemplatesHelp: Write a template, or draft one with AI, to use it in a campaign.
outreach.fromCRM: People in CRM with an email address
outreach.noCRMPeople: No CRM people with an email address yet.

outreach.postalAddress: Postal address shown in every email
outreach.noCampaignsHelp: Set up a sending domain and sender, write a template, then create a campaign.

blockers.no_sendable_recipients: Nobody in the audience can be emailed.

outreach.unsubscribed: You are unsubscribed. {{sender}} will not email you again.
outreach.unsubscribeInvalid: This unsubscribe link is not valid.

modeHelp.opt_in: Visitors are counted anonymously until they accept analytics. Only then are visits linked into sessions.
modeHelp.opt_out: Visits are linked into sessions unless the visitor declines. Check this is allowed where your visitors are.
modeHelp.cookieless_only: Only anonymous page views are counted. Nothing is stored in the visitor's browser.

visitors.noSitesHelp: Add a website to get its install snippet.
visitors.installHelp: Add this to every page of the website, and connect it to your consent banner with window.mspTrack.consent("granted") or ("denied").

ip.truncate_then_discard: On: a shortened network address is checked, then discarded

visitors.privacyNote: IP addresses are never stored. Query strings are removed except utm_ parameters. Visit data is deleted after {{days}} days.
visitors.companiesHelp: Companies matched from visitors' networks. A match is an estimate, not proof of who visited.

chat.fakeNotice: Answers come from the fake AI provider until a real one is approved. Install bots only on the local test site or websites the team controls.
chat.noBotsHelp: Create a bot, give it knowledge, then activate it for your website.
chat.allowedOrigins: Websites it may appear on (comma separated)
chat.disclosureHelp: Visitors always see this notice, so they know they are talking to software.
chat.installHelp: Add this to the website's pages. It only works on the websites listed above.
chat.knowledgeHelp: The bot answers only from this text. If it does not cover a question, the bot passes it to your team.
chat.questionsHelp: Asked when a visitor leaves their details. Answered questions add their weight to the lead's score.
chat.question: Question
chat.noConversationsHelp: Conversations from your website appear here.
